_comment: The work, machine-readable. Exactly ONE item may have status 'in_progress'. Nothing becomes 'passing' without `make verify` output pasted into 'evidence'. See bmad/checklists/definition_of_done.md.

features.title: Minimal harness, semi-agent and agent run end to end
features.user_visible_behavior: make demo completes: File D accepts 3 of 3 objectives, both Part 3 variants produce reports, the agent stops on its own stop condition.
features.evidence: make verify -> exit 0, all checks ok. make demo -> exit 0; agent reached 'Stopping. The report exists and contains a section for all 3 input documents.'
features.notes: Verified against tools/mock_ollama.py. Re-run against a real model before any session (workflow W2).

features.title: Document assistant answers with citations and refuses when uncovered
features.user_visible_behavior: Covered questions answer with resolvable [S#] citations; uncovered questions are refused at the retrieval gate before any model call.
features.evidence: make eval MODEL=mock:demo -> retrieval hit 100%, answered-when-expected 100%, refused-when-expected 100% (12 questions).
features.notes: Thresholds MIN_RETRIEVAL_SCORE=5.0 and MIN_TERM_COVERAGE=0.55 are tuned to the synthetic demo corpus and WILL be wrong for any other corpus.

features.title: Timeline, decks, cheatsheet, runbooks and use cases complete
features.user_visible_behavior: A facilitator can deliver Part 2 and Part 4 sessions from these files without further preparation beyond the runbook.
verification: render both LiaScript decks at liascript.github.io
features.evidence: make verify -> liascript checks pass on both decks (12 and 13 answered questions, 45 and 41 speaker-note blocks); all relative links resolve.
features.notes: UNESCO terminology corrected to Acquire/Deepen/Create; the 'AI-literate / AI-enhanced' phrasing in the original brief is flagged as non-UNESCO in PART1 and 00_INDEX.

features.title: Copilot and Continue surfaces defined over shared bmad/ doctrine
features.user_visible_behavior: Six custom agents appear in the VS Code agents dropdown with working handoffs; the same six slash commands exist in both Copilot and Continue.
verification: open the workspace in VS Code and confirm the agents dropdown lists all six
features.evidence: make verify -> agents checks pass: 6 agents, 6 prompts, 3 instruction files, all handoff targets resolve, .continue/config.yaml points only at 127.0.0.1.
features.notes: Tool names in agent frontmatter follow the VS Code custom-agent format as of July 2026; unavailable tools are ignored by VS Code rather than erroring.

features.title: Interactive six-layer learning page and the layer-5 agent
features.user_visible_behavior: LEARN_the_five_layers.html opens with no network and walks a reader from tokens to a self-improving agent, with a prompt inspector that grows at each layer. wiki_agent.py evolves a skill file and rolls back a bad proposal.
features.evidence: make verify -> exit 0 (offline check now covers HTML assets and browser storage). make demo -> exit 0; layer 5 arc 0% -> 33% -> 67% -> ROLLED BACK -> 100%. Page logic exercised headlessly: stack grows 0/1/2/5/6/8 blocks, 0 -> 239 tokens across the six layers.
features.notes: Layer-5 figures are from WikiSkill (arXiv:2608.27454). Demos replay real script output via the mock so the page works with no model installed; the tokenizer is a stated approximation.

features.title: Validate every component against a real local model, not the mock
features.user_visible_behavior: make eval and make demo produce sensible output with llama3.1:8b and qwen2.5:7b on the session machine.
verification: python3 ask.py 'What is the capital city of Peru?' --model llama3.1:8b  # must refuse
features.notes: BLOCKING for any session. make demo uses the mock and therefore cannot catch a missing or broken model. This is workflow W2 step 2.

features.title: Replace the 12 demo questions with 30-50 collected from real staff
features.user_visible_behavior: eval_questions.json contains real institutional questions, including at least eight the corpus does not cover.
features.notes: Collect the questions BEFORE building anything for a pilot. Twelve is a demonstration; this is the difference between a demo and a pilot.
